title: 第48章 你要婆娘吗？

第48章 你要婆娘吗？-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

日头高高挂起！

不过，落在老林子里面的时候，斑斑点点，能够清晰看到一道道光束从空中落在脚下，李青山一路走到小溪边，将调配好的药汁顺着小溪边和周围蔷薇属植物的树叶涂抹。

自己调配的这药汁，不仅能干翻香獐子。

要是獐子，狍子，麂子，梅花鹿，马鹿之类的吃了，也都得被干翻，虽然自己得这一番操作，不一定能够狩猎到香獐子，但说不定却可以狩猎到其他的野物呢！

花费了一个多小时。

李青山这才将一水壶的药汁涂抹干净，走到小溪边将其冲洗干净，涮了好几次李青山才放心。

回到趟子房的时候，大壮等人还在忙碌着。

笼子里的獐子已经晕死过去了，现在尚未醒来，这让李青山满意的点了点头，别到时候将香獐子干翻了后，过一会自己醒过来后逃走了，那可就白忙活了。

“大壮，都休息一下吧！”

“恢复恢复体力，咱们大概下午三点多，四点钟不到的时候出发狩猎！”

李青山开口道。

“好嘞！”

大壮等人纷纷点头，先去小溪边冲了个澡，然后匆匆跑回来午休。

大黄在一旁打着哈欠。

跟着李青山后顿顿吃肉，身子上的膘也开始逐渐恢复了。

石溪村！

赵贵一家子这两日倒霉的很，先是被赶出家门，如今儿媳妇也走了，大晚上的还被人家打了一顿。

虽然能猜得出来，肯定是李青山干的。

但是没有证据啊！

儿子的腿，都被打折了，可是没钱看，现在只能临时处理一下，躺在草房子里面哀嚎着。

要是这么下去，这条腿，非要瘸了才行。

村子里已经有了个赵瞎子，现在又要来了个赵瘸子了。

一旦瘸了。

这辈子媳妇算是说不上了，更别提孙子了，这可是要老赵家断子绝孙的事情啊！！

唉，这可怎么办啊！

赵贵老两口，准备来找本家的支书为自己做主，至于村长，那就是一个不靠谱的，那是老李家的人，怎么可能向着自己呢？

“支书，王乃香怎么也是咱们老赵家的儿媳妇，结果跟着老李家的人走了，而且李青山那二流子可是说了，老赵家的谁敢多管闲事，就打断谁腿，这不是看不起咱们老赵家吗？”

“以后，这让村子里的其他姓怎么看咱们老赵家？”

“还有村长，徇私舞弊，竟然将保健站大夫的名额给了李青山，凭什么啊？”

The sun is rising high!

However, when he landed in the old forest, he could clearly see spots of light falling from the sky below his feet. Li Qingshan walked all the way to the stream and applied the prepared concoction along the stream and the leaves of the surrounding rose plants.

The concoction I prepared is not only good at fragrant deer.

If deer, roe deer, muntjac, sika deer, red deer, etc. are eaten, they will all be killed. Although you may not be able to hunt fragrant deer through this operation, you may be able to hunt other wild animals!

It took over an hour.

Li Qingshan then smeared the potion of concoction cleanly, walked to the stream and rinsed it clean. After rinsing it several times, Li Qingshan felt relieved.

When they returned to Tangzi's room, Da Zhuang and others were still busy.

The deer in the cage had fainted and had not yet woken up. This made Li Qingshan nod with satisfaction. Don't knock the fragrant deer over and wake up and escape after a while. That would be in vain.

"Dazhuang, everyone, please take a rest!"

"Recover and regain your strength. Let's start hunting around three o'clock in the afternoon, maybe before four o'clock!"

Li Qingshan said.

"Okay!"

Da Zhuang and others nodded, first went to the stream to take a shower, and then hurried back to take a lunch break.

Dahuang yawned on the side.

After following Li Qingshan, I ate meat every day, and the fat on my body began to gradually recover.

Stony Brook Village!

Zhao Gui's family has been very unlucky these past two days. First they were kicked out of the house, and now their daughter-in-law has also left. They were even beaten up late at night.

Although it can be guessed, it must have been Li Qingshan.

But there is no evidence!

My son's legs were broken, but he didn't have money to look after them, so now he can only deal with them temporarily, lying in the thatched house and wailing.

If this continues, this leg will become lame.

There is already a blind Zhao in the village, and now another lame Zhao is coming.

Once lame.

In this life, I can't even talk about a daughter-in-law, let alone a grandson. This is something that will end the old Zhao family's descendants!!

Alas, what can we do?

Zhao Gui and his wife are going to find their branch secretary to make the decision for them. As for the village chief, he is unreliable. He is from Lao Li's family. How could he be against them?

"Party secretary, how come Wang Naixiang is also the daughter-in-law of our old Zhao family, and ended up following the old Li family, and that second-rate Li Qingshan said that anyone from the old Zhao family who dares to meddle in other people's business will have their legs broken. Isn't this looking down on our old Zhao family?"

"In the future, what will other people in the village think of our old Zhao family?"

"And the village chief, practicing favoritism and malpractice, actually gave the position of doctor at the health station to Li Qingshan. Why?"
